paraphrase: Registration of the pre-existing branch controls: irreflexive mixed priority with both directions between two Unit tokens; transitive mixed priority with both directions; and a Unit-act/Bool-bearer interpretation satisfying both productive interfaces and both order laws with an occurring act producing candidate false.
